title: Capability: item-granted creatures via the summon system
description: Selected under the user's 2026-10-12 rule (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent): this structure stays TYPED in the SRD pack because a positive engine capability is more likely than not in the near future, so the capability must exist before the re-freeze (eshyra-o9bd.14). Capability contract per ADR 0020 / eshyra-olc5: operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real binding to the pack fields, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed for unsupported input. Pack shape is owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (PR #656); coordinate field shapes with it rather than changing the pack later. Scope: entity grants (creature refs, count, duration, reversion at 0 HP / duration end, e.g. Figurine of Wondrous Power, elemental vessels with the conjure-elemental concentration exception, Bag of Tricks, Staff of the Python) create and remove encounter combatants through the existing bonded-summon/combatant lifecycle (RecastBondedSummon, TransitionBondedSummon, encounterCombatants). Control/obedience policy stays DM-adjudicated.

Repairs paused; surfaced to user for keep / DM-adjudicate / other. PR #665 head a3943b51 left open, not merged. olc5.13 restacked onto main as PR #666 (independent).
DESIGN RECONCILIATION after Sol r2 (eshyra-olc5.12.11, S8-S13). Decided by Claude Captain with the user, 2026-10-17. Supersedes further per-finding patching.

PRINCIPLE: the DM declares transitions; the engine computes clocks. Fixed printed clocks and amounts stay deterministic: grant identity and variant admission, cooldown spend, fixed grant lifetime timers, grant-ended anchor arithmetic, and the printed Conjure Elemental uncontrolled-successor deadline (SRD p.128). Transitions the source does not fix, such as partial creature removal, ad-hoc lifetime rewrites, and what a destroyed source item does, are not inferred by the engine. Those paths either refuse and route to an explicit whole-grant end_effect with a ruling, or carry a tombstone that ends cleanly. ADR 0017 hierarchy: procedural where printed, model adjudication otherwise. ADR 0020: the adjudication boundary is recorded as an explicit limit, not a completeness claim.

PER FINDING:
S8 (successor/refresh lifetime): the successor inherits the predecessor's item_grant_json and duration provenance verbatim. refresh_effect on ANY grant-bound effect (predecessor or successor) refuses every duration change, with or without a dm-adjudicated override, and names end_effect as the route. The S5 refresh-override path for grant-bound effects is withdrawn (narrowing; non-grant effects unchanged). The concentration break then always finds the printed timed row.
S9 (cascade-created successor not expired): kept deterministic, because the successor is the pre-existing printed spell rule and is not item-specific. expireElapsedWorldEffects becomes a fixpoint loop: repeatedly select the earliest live due world-time row (deadline <= target) and finalize it, until none remains. This processes rows in effective-time order, including rows created during the same advance. It must stay idempotent and atomic and terminate (each iteration ends one row; guard on non-performed claims).
S10 (resolver dropped): forward resolveRulesPack in the nested character addCondition in toolStartEffect/activeEffects. Make the resolver key REQUIRED (explicitly typed, may be undefined) on the mutation context types, so the compiler forces every construction site to state it.
S11 (destroyed source): tombstone. destroyInventoryItem (the single choke point for every destruction path, including item-rule consumption such as Elemental Gem) marks the item_grant_json of every live effect bound to that instance as source-destroyed. finalizeEnd then ends the grant without scheduling a cooldown anchor. Expiry, end_effect, refresh-refusal and the resolver lookups must not require the deleted inventory row for a tombstoned binding. Destruction is NOT refused: item rules legitimately destroy sources.
S12 (final actor via remove_effect_target): remove_effect_target refuses to remove a grant-bound linked creature of a grant-bound effect, routing to end_effect for the whole grant. No partial departure path for bound grants.
S13: amortize the figurine-variant loop setup (or give it a measured local timeout); keep its assertions. No global timeout changes.

OUT OF SCOPE (unchanged owners): .12.3 non-anchored spend coupling, .12.4 Efreeti outcomes, c58j F3/F2 hooks, control/hostility/obedience.
